title: the light and shadow descriptions of visualizationSettings are misleading
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026b step RG6.4. Two things, both from the maintainer, 2026-09-23. First, every member of a light repeats "of GL_LIGHT0" (1,2,3): within a light that is noise and it should read "of this light", with the mapping of light0..light3 to GL_LIGHT0..GL_LIGHT3 said once, at the enable flag of the light. Second, the remarks are out of date: they say light0 is the one used for shadows, which was a performance decision that no longer holds - every light can cast shadows now. And the sentence "approximates directional lights by enlarging the direction to 200 times maxSceneSize" belongs to the shadow settings, not to a light, and it should not name a factor that has already changed once and will change again.
releaseNotes: revision2026b step RG6.4. The six members of VSettingsLight that repeated 'of GL_LIGHT[0,1,2,3]' read 'of this light' now, and the mapping - light0 to light3 are OpenGL GL_LIGHT0 to GL_LIGHT3 - is stated once, at enable. The claim in position that light0 is the light used for shadows is gone: shadow says that every light can cast one and that the effects accumulate, which the raytracer half of the same description had said all along. The directional-light approximation moved from position, where it described shadows rather than a light, into shadow, and it names no factor any more - 'a multiple of maxSceneSize' instead of '200 times maxSceneSize', because a constant that lives only in a description is wrong the day someone tunes it. A stale reference to light0Position in shadowSmoothingSteps and two deprecated names in docs/manual/introductionBasics.md (openGL.enableLight1, openGL.light0position) went with them.
